desc: The Archangel AACQS Close Quarter Stock for Springfield Armory M1A and M14 rifles is a feature packed, super lightweight pistol grip combat stock that features a streamlined, six position collapsible buttstock and practical accessory mounting capabilities. The collapsible buttstock provides length of pull adjustment from 11.5" to 14.5" and features an anti-snag rubber recoil pad. The removable pistol grip features a locking storage compartment and is contoured and textured for positive weapon control and retention. For sling accommodation, there are 2 standard UM style sling studs one in the forend and one in the buttstock. Additionally, there are five embedded steel, flush-cup style QD hardpoints. One on each side of the forend, one on each side just above the pistol grip, and one on the toe of the buttstock. (QD sling swivels not included). The wide, flat and ventilated forearm keeps the barrel cool, and features M-LOK slots at 3, 6, and 9 O'clock positions at the leading end of the forend. The precision inlet has been optimized for a drop-in precise fit with the utmost in accuracy potential. Constructed of ProMag's legendary high strength, carbon fiber and glass reinforced black polymer. Impervious to weather, most firearms solvents and lubricants, this tough as nails stock will withstand a lifetime of hard use. Only 2.8 lbs. Made in USA.
